name: @vscar/used-adjustment
description: VScar Used Adjustment v0.1 (Step 8a): adds used-instance context (age, mileage, asking price, warranty, battery health, service/accident/condition) to a ReferenceVariant without rewriting the engines. Effective purchase price, Used Information Confidence, Ownership Signals and Verification Requirements as messageKey + params. No market value, depreciation, failure probability or range degradation. Pure, deterministic, browser-safe.
